audiences.solicitor: full served application record, own-client privilege and time-specific order analysis
audiences.client: plain-language current position/obligations without privileged strategy, unsafe witness contact or unnecessary third-party data
audiences.court: filed/served material and separately controlled restricted evidence as authorised
audiences.CPS: prosecution record and served defence bail material; no defence privilege
audiences.internal_review: complete designed truth, conflict, state and leakage scoring with role controls

exit_contracts: risk evidence, submission, reason and order never collapse
proposed surety/address never becomes accepted without source
breach wording remains alleged unless court state proves otherwise
CTL inputs and uncertainty survive copy/export/API/prose
substantive correctness and containment scored separately

source_scoring.mandatory_finding_recall: charge, risk, address, surety, condition, service, breach, order and deadline states
source_scoring.unsupported_statement_precision: penalise guilt, risk, breach, suitability, order and CTL overclaim
source_scoring.defendant_matter_isolation: D1 and third parties remain correctly attributed within R15
source_scoring.audience_leakage: zero tolerance for defence privilege, unsafe witness contact, excess health/financial data or internal deliberation
